name: Norman stone farmhouse (longere)
description: Norman longere, 15 x 7 m: rubble-limestone walls under a steep slate roof. Kitchen with an open hearth (west), the salle with a curtained box bed and armoire (middle), and the cellier with barrels and the churn (east, its own door). Two front doors, a rear kitchen door, shuttered casements. Single storey (loft closed). B2: Pays d'Auge colombage on the front (oak posts, rails and braces over rendered infill), dressed rubble rear and gables, chamfered plinth, two dormers in the steep slate roof, a capped stack, ivy on the cellier gable.
